source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Good evening, [CLIENT_NAME_001].
Attached is the first fully completed version of the drawings. Because I still have not received details explaining how the bushing is to be fitted and retained, please disregard its present design. For now, the drawing simply shows it fastened by three screws.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports attaching the first fully completed drawing version while identifying the bushing design as provisional.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: That is not a problem. A complete set of drawings would be best, and I will review it tomorrow.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: I have included two files containing the same drawings: one is the color version, while the other is the standard black-and-white version. I’ll wait for your feedback :)

execution.observed_behavior: In response to the complete-set request, the freelancer reports delivering the drawings in two files with color and black-and-white presentation variants.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi,
[FREELANCER_NAME_003] you for sending the final revision. Honestly, the drawings look quite good. As mentioned before, if any further small changes arise, would you still be willing to make them after we close this project?
You may also release all the files as previously agreed.
[FREELANCER_NAME_003] you.

execution.observed_behavior: After reviewing the final drawing revision, the client states that the drawings look quite good and authorizes release of the agreed files.

routing_warnings.description: The instruction to keep only 3D views colored and make all other views black-and-white changes drawing presentation rather than drawing-set completeness.
The requests for PDF, DWG/DXF, STEP, and editable native files belong to the delivery-format Requirement.
The instructions to add the functional hole distance and bracket the overall length concern technical drawing annotations.
The confirmed PDF, DWG, STEP, and editable SolidWorks outputs concern delivery formats.
The corrected shaft-blank reference dimensions concern drawing annotations rather than completeness of the drawing set.
